meta.name: implement
meta.description: Implement a piece of work based on a spec or set of tickets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据规格或工单实现功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需按规格或工单编写代码
copy.tagline_en: Implement features based on specs or tickets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to code according to specifications or tickets

howto.what: 根据用户提供的 PRD 或任务列表，自动实现代码功能。它会按约定使用 TDD 模式，定期运行类型检查和测试，最后执行代码审查并提交到当前分支。
howto.when: 当用户给出产品需求文档（PRD）或一组任务（issues），并要求实现时触发。

say.text: 请根据这个 PRD 实现功能。
say.note: 技能会读取 PRD 并开始编码。

say.text: 这里有三个 issue，请实现它们。
say.note: 技能会依次处理每个 issue。

howto.what_en: Implements code based on a PRD or set of issues. Uses TDD where agreed, runs type checks and tests regularly, then does a code review and commits to the current branch.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a PRD or issues and asks to implement them.

say_en.text: Please implement the feature based on this PRD.
say_en.note: The skill reads the PRD and starts coding.

say_en.text: Here are three issues, please implement them.
say_en.note: The skill processes each issue in turn.
